column1: # C oracle registry — see rust/docs/ORACLES.md. Tab-separated. One row per
# named, pinned C build. `source` is a git submodule path relative to the repo
# root; `mode` is `live` (build the submodule's working tree, which temporary
# instrumentation may patch) or `pinned` (materialise `commit` with git
# archive into $ZENAV1_ORACLE_CACHE). `api` is `fork` when the build carries
# svt-av1-hdr's EbSvtAv1EncConfiguration fields, `mainline` when it does not.
# `driver_defs` are -D flags for tools/capture_c_trace, one per C API difference
# the wrappers must bridge (each is documented where wrap_recon.c tests it).
# `rust_reference` and `rust_hdr_mode` are what identity_run selects for it.
